title: Impeach court to vote on conviction threshold as Cayetano motion fails

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court will proceed to divide the floor on the voting threshold to convict Vice President Sara Duterte after majority of its members voted on Wednesday against a motion to defer doing so. Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano, earlier, moved to defer the voting on whether the court must require 16 votes to convict Duterte. READ: Poa: Change in vote threshold may affect provisions in Constitution Cayetano asserted that the Supreme Court should decide the matter because it involves a provision of the Constitution.
